content: Servers RequestResponseDelay for received Sub- scribeEventGroup entries The Server will delay the SubscribeEventGroupAck answer to a received SubscribeEventGroup message that was triggered by a multicast ServiceOffer by the configured SomeipSdServerEventGroupTim- ingConfig . requestResponseDelay that is referenced by the EventHandler in the role sdServerEgTimingConfig . The actual delay will be randomly chosen between the maxValue and minValue .
